items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I was the first of Cadet Love and the SP... we played in there that night in Cadet Love.

ctx.x: They'll follow, that's all. Those you lead, they're going to follow. They call me a father player. I need my music you know. I was the first of Cadet Love and the SP, when the Navy first come there. The first building they had there, they had a dance for the soldiers. And we played in there that night in Cadet Love. Cadet Love? Cadet Love. Oh yeah. Yeah, Cadet Love. Cadet Love. Cadet Love. Oh yeah. Yeah. Cadet Love. I wanted to ask some more about your very early life. Over in Algiers, just where were you living…
I was living in Soxer Lane.
